message.content:
**MSFT** is the ticker symbol for **Microsoft Corporation**, one of the largest publicly‑traded companies listed on the NASDAQ exchange. On Yahoo Finance you’ll see it under “Ticker Symbol” or simply “Symbol.” It’s commonly referenced when looking up:

| Item | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **Company name** | Microsoft Corp. |
| **Exchange** | NASDAQ |
| **Sector/Industry** | Technology – Software—Infrastructure |
| **Stock type** | Common Stock |

On Yahoo Finance, searching for `MSFT` will bring up its latest market data, charts, news articles, financial statements, analyst estimates, dividend history, and other investor resources. If you need the most recent share price or specific metrics, just enter `MSFT` into the search bar on [finance.yahoo.com](https://finance.yahoo.com) and select the company from the dropdown list.
